title: Leaner dependencies
items: Code in the docs and the blog is highlighted in the same colours as the dashboard, in light and dark mode
The interactive API explorer is retired; /api-explorer now opens the REST API docs, and the OpenAPI description stays at /openapi.yaml
API routes answer 400 instead of 500 when a request body is not the JSON object they expect
About 200 fewer packages in the web app's dependency tree, and fewer crates in the receiver and the CLI
